cast.name: The Protagonist

Show him five times side by side, full body front view, same face and hair in every pose, deadpan expression: (1) plain black hoodie with the hood up and a gray foam splint with velcro straps on his right wrist, (2) black hoodie with the hood down, (3) black crewneck sweater, (4) black quarter-zip pullover, (5) dark tailored jacket over a black tee. Plain light-gray background, outfit labels under each pose. {STYLE}
